name: Patch-based Probability Volume Histogram (PVH) Inference
definition: A method to compute the overall likelihood of occupancy for a given voxel $p(VL_i)$ by aggregating probabilities from multiple camera views $C$ using a sigmoid function, creating a Probability Volume Histogram (PVH) for volume $VL$.
summary: Patch-based Probability Volume Histogram Inference refines occupancy estimates by processing densely sampled 3D patches through a CNN, distinguishing itself from sibling methods by handling sparse or noisy input data.
